item.title: The Trump administration still aims to make state citizenship lists ahead of midterms
item.description: The Trump administration is taking the unprecedented step of creating lists of adult citizens who are eligible to vote in each state – but will not meet its own deadline 60 days before Election Day.
item.content:encoded:
The Trump administration is taking the unprecedented step of creating lists of adult citizens who are eligible to vote in each state – but will not meet its own deadline 60 days before Election Day.

(Image credit: Scott Olson)

item.title: Leon Black defies subpoena to testify in Epstein inquiry and sues House panel
item.description: The billionaire investor is under two subpoenas from the House Oversight Committee. But in his lawsuit, Black says the panel doesn't have the authority to compel him to share nondisclosure agreements.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to lift block on USPS plan to restrict mail voting
item.description: The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court to lift a temporary block on the U.S. Postal Service plan for President Trump's attempt to restrict mail-in voting for the midterm election.

item.title: Tributes to Gloria Steinem are flooding in, from Hollywood to Capitol Hill
item.description: Women in politics and pop culture are paying tribute to Gloria Steinem after her death at 92. Many called her not only an inspiration but a friend.

item.title: Later in life, Gloria Steinem found herself free of the 'demands of gender'
item.description: In 2015, the trailblazing feminist told Fresh Air she that had entered a new phase in life, one in which "you can do what you want." Steinem died Sept. 2 at the age of 92.

item.title: Gloria Steinem, trailblazing journalist and activist, dies at 92
item.description: At a time when women were largely limited to domestic roles, Steinem challenged gender stereotypes and championed feminist ideals like equality, sisterhood and reproductive freedom.

item.title: As millions of kids lose SNAP food benefits, free school meals are also at risk
item.description: Food stamps have a direct link to other critical resources, such as free breakfast and lunch at school. Now, experts say they're starting to see that link break.

item.title: Trump administration mulls renaming USS Doris Miller
item.description: The Trump administration is considering stripping the name of an African American war hero from an aircraft carrier, even though President Trump himself praised the honor in his first term.

item.title: Jury is deadlocked in Lindsay Clancy's trial
item.description: Jurors in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts woman charged with murdering her three children, are deadlocked after five days of deliberation.
